Weapon Lvl is this gun's level. Unlocks carry over to compatible guns, so a part you've already unlocked on another gun is ready to use.
Tier: sources disagree
Our main stat tracker moved it up to its top tier, "Absolute Meta", after the Nov 13 range buff. A second stat tracker had it in its top tier, which it calls Meta, on Nov 10, and we could not re-read its list after the update.
Build: sources disagree
We list our main stat tracker's top Multiplayer build, which it changed for Season 1 on Nov 6. A second stat tracker's Versatile build (Oct 23) shares the FSS IS300, and runs the SA Laz-500, ZLR ASP50 Stock, ZLR Phase Grip and FSS Fireline Grip instead. It hasn't changed that build since Season 1.
Apex fire rate: sources disagree
The official weapons post says the Hurricane fires faster, but our main stat tracker and a third stat tracker both list about 14% lower fire rate. Try it in the firing range before you rely on either.
How do you unlock the M16 Burst?
The M16 Burst is a new attachment for the M4 that swaps its full-auto fire for controlled bursts, so it handles like an M16. It's a Season 1 event reward, and the official Season 1 post marks it as arriving during the season rather than at launch.
Activision hasn't said yet which event awards it or what you'll need to do. We'll add the steps here once the event is announced.
Checked

Slot: sources disagree
Our main stat tracker files the M16 Burst as an Apex, which would mean you can't run it alongside the M4 Hurricane. The official Season 1 post and a guide site list it as a regular attachment, separate from the Apexes.

Apex attachment · Lvl 72
M4 Hurricane
Converts the M4 into a light, top-loading 5.7x28mm variant with a 50-round magazine. Horizontal recoil drops by about 27% and bullet velocity by about 18%. It blocks barrels and magazines, so drop the barrel from the endgame build to run it.
Unlocks at weapon max level and doesn't take one of your five attachment slots.
